# Control-document access

> **TL;DR:** who may read (R), write (W: the whole document; S: only the sections it owns) or lock on approval (L) each control document. The engine installs only a writer's owned sections and reports every other edit, refuses a change to a locked document without an approved change request, and blocks the run on a hand edit (see [control documents](control-documents.md)).

| Node | product | research | experience | design | prototype | development | evaluation | memory |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `n02_evidence_review` Research and evidence review | · | S | · | · | · | · | · | R |
